doc.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018

title: Catch a Rising Star and the Donald Fagen band
summary: Singing between comics led to Donald Fagen's band and Steely Dan touring, and calls from famous people.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: his shows so he started doing HBO shows, so I was called to do that as a result of doing demos for Bob Stein, who is his musical director. So like all these things kind of started happening and then I started sitting in in bands in New York. And then I was doing weddings at the same time, meeting people, just meeting people. I said I don’t know what I’m doing but I’m just going to try to meet as many people as I can. So then I started singing at Catch a Rising Star comedy club in between comedians, many of whom you know, including like Joy Behar, Susie Essman, all these people who used to — we all had 15 minute slots and the singer would — usually they’d put the singer on after somebody famous because other comics didn’t want to follow that person. Like if Robin Williams or Eddie Murphy came in then one of us would go on after them because nobody wanted to follow them type of thing. Then they had a little trio that used to play the comics on and off. [Scats] Right? So the drummer of that trio was playing in another band, said, “Why don’t you come up here. I think that — I work in a band, I think they would like you up here.” So it turns out that that was the band that turned into the back-up band for Donald Fagen, that started doing the New York Nights shows in New York which then turned into the reformation of Steely Dan touring. So then that’s how I got to have people call me on the phone. So in those days you had cassettes in the answering machine. So every time somebody famous called me I would keep the cassette. So you know I have: “Hi Catherine, this is Donald Fagen.” So after that I pull that tape out and keep that. And then, “Hi Catherine, this is Paul Simon.” So I have that someplace. So you know, so eventually I didn’t know how I was going to get there but eventually I got there.
That’s terrific. It’s very refreshing that that is special to you.
